Vehicle.description: M1 cooperative-awareness custom VSS overlay. Not standard VSS — three opaque relay signals carrying the R1/R2/R4 payloads unchanged (base64 or JSON text) between the KUKSA-pin blueprint variant's nodes. See carsky-kuksa-blueprint-guide.md.

V2X.description: M1 hackathon custom namespace — not part of the standard COVESA VSS catalog.

M1.description: One signal per R6 communication leg in the KUKSA-pin blueprint variant.

BenchToV2xCpmB64.description: R1 CPM: full ASN.1 UPER-encoded Vanetza CPM byte string, base64-encoded. Published by Bench Scenario Player, consumed by V2X ECU. Payload bytes are identical to the R1 profile over raw UDP — only the transport changed.

V2xToAdaObjectJson.description: R2 V2X ECU -> ADA ECU object message, verbatim JSON text (same schema as the UDP-based R2 contract).

AdaToIviWarningJson.description: R4 ADA ECU -> IVI ECU warning/state message, verbatim JSON text (same schema as the UDP-based R4 contract).
